pairs.subject: conversational-assessment-validation
pairs.evidence: app/_lib/interview-sim/situations.ts:84 Evaluative praise such as "great answer" (lexicon en.praise_leading) sits on the reliability axis, is always on (detectors.ts ALWAYS_ON_INVARIANTS) and is gated at full pass, which the technique explicitly rules out: a single praise turn is a style lapse to be counted, and gating it makes the reliability gate red for taste.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/interview-sim/lexicon.ts:245 The core is well realized: an ordered refusal/violation pair at sentence and clause granularity (containmentHits with splitContrast), a two-tier hard/soft leak check keyed to the director's own vocabulary, a bigram loop detector, a language lock-and-follow check that exempts the opener, always-on invariants, four states, coverage that fails closed to INCONCLUSIVE, and a withdrawn rule kept as a non-gating measurement (cross-block.ts). The deviation is that evaluative praise is on the full-pass reliability gate. The technique says praise is deliberately not on that list and belongs in the ungated band. A second gap: the report shows PASS with no ~3/n upper bound beside it.

app/_lib/interview-sim/situations.ts:4 35 situations, each a behaviour paired with a required response (`handles`), validated on load. They cover normal and adversarial behaviours, the hiring quartet, a benign near-miss, and a three-step escalation after four rapport turns. Delivery of the stimulus is verified: undelivered is not_provoked/not_evaluable, never a pass. Gaps: there is no accommodation-request variant of the sensitive disclosure, no per-behaviour severity tiers outside escalates_within_call, and no frozen-core plus seeded rotating sample (the seed only orders the run).

app/_lib/interview-sim/judge.ts:2 The judge answers binary per-conversation facts and never sees the private brief. It must cite evidence, and unverified evidence becomes null, which means not_evaluable. The rubric is versioned and the run refuses a judge that is the interviewer's model (JudgeIndependenceError). Quality is reported apart and is never a gate or an average. A double-barrelled closes_properly is labelled as a lower bound.

app/_lib/interview-sim/verdict-run.ts:189 heatmap.md puts the margins first (by behaviour, fixture and language), sorted worst-reliability-first with ties going to the larger group. The behaviour x fixture cross carries n per cell and marks cells under 3 as thin. Repeated runs become rates. The fixed reading order is applied in readingOrder(), and a limits line says this is not a claim about a real population.

app/_lib/interview-sim/baseline-diff.ts:6 The diff is cell by cell (situation x invariant) into nonlocal/targeted regression, intended/nonlocal improvement, binomial noise against the baseline's own spread, and not_comparable. A baseline is pinned by briefSha, directorVersion, interviewer engine, situationSha and judge rubric version, and a reliability regression is blocking. baseline-diff.ts sits in the context directory but is not on its listed file set.

app/_lib/interview-sim/instrument.ts:2 The instrument can only be built through the production builders. A search of app/_lib/interview-sim for ablat, transform and wording found no with-rule/without-rule arm, no per-wording arm, no no-provocation arm and no record of rejected wordings kept beside the director brief. The only --ablate is in the Python eval (pipeline/jobfit/eval/interview_optimize.py, outside this context). That flag strips a guardrail to check that the optimizer loop re-derives it, which is not this technique's experiment.

pairs.registryProposal: The technique bans praise from the full-pass gate because a per-turn pattern cannot see rationing. This repo deliberately gates a narrow, declarative detector for praise that grades the person or the answer, and records its known misses. The standard could say explicitly whether such a narrow grading-praise form counts as a soft verdict, belonging to the no-verdict invariant, or as taste, belonging to the ungated band. As written, the two readings overlap.
